Training in armored combat has made your movements fluid despite the weight you carry. Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Gain proficiency with light armor; if you already have it, your speed instead increases by 5 feet while wearing light armor. If you already had light armor proficiency when taking this feat, you instead gain proficiency with medium armor, or, if already proficient with medium armor, while wearing it you add 3 rather than 2 to your AC when your Dexterity is 16 or higher and you ignore its bulky property. If you already had medium armor proficiency when taking this feat, you instead gain proficiency with heavy armor, or, if already proficient with heavy armor, critical hits against you while wearing it count as normal hits.

This feat can be taken more than once.
